Latest Audit Reports

Bad_Magic_Numbers_Audit_20260324.md 2026-03-24 08:47:16
# Bad Magic Numbers Audit - 2026-03-24 (RESOLVED) This report details findings related to "magic numbers" (hardcoded numeric literals) within the OPEN-AIR project, and tracks the resolution of Mandate 31 compliance. ## Summary of Findings (Resolved) A comprehensive refactoring has been performed across several core modules to externalize magic numbers into dedicated `Constants/` directories. This improves maintainability and ensures that logic, layout, and communication parameters are centralized and named. ## Resolutions by Module ### `oaComSNMP` * Created `oaComSNMP/Constants/snmp_constants.py`. * Externalized `THREAD_JOIN_TIMEOUT`, `LOG_POLLING_INTERVAL`, `STATE_SYNC_INTERVAL`, `OID_MAP_STR_LIMIT`, `BASE_OID`, and `MIN_LOG_PARTS`. * Updated `snmp_log_monitor.py`, `oid_map_converter.py`, `snmp_tree.py`, `snmp_manager.py`, and `snmp_state_persister.py`. ### `oaComMQTT` * Updated `oaComMQTT/Constants/mqtt_config.py`. * Externalized `ASYNC_JOIN_TIMEOUT`, `QUEUE_GET_TIMEOUT`, `MATCH_CACHE_LIMIT`, and other worker settings. * Updated `mqtt_subscriber_router.py`. ### `oaGuiBuilder` * Created `oaGuiBuilder/Constants/builder_constants.py`. * Externalized `SCROLL_SYNC_DELAY`, `RESIZE_THROTTLE_DELAY`, `RESIZE_WIDTH_THRESHOLD`, and `SLICING_*` parameters. * Updated `builder.py`, `hidden_BreakLine.py`, and `slicing_registry.py`. ### `oaGuiSplashScreen` * Created `oaGuiSplashScreen/Constants/splash_constants.py`. * Externalized `DEFAULT_GIF_DURATION` and `MIN_GIF_DURATION`. * Updated `gif_animator.py`. ### `oaGuiElements` * Created `oaGuiElements/Constants/gui_constants.py`. * Externalized grid spacing, dial scaling/thresholds, wink button physics, and color fallbacks. * Updated `grid.py`, `winkdemo.py`, `state_sync.py`, and `utils.py`. ## Remaining Work 1. **`oaStyle` Refactoring**: Many hardcoded hex colors and font sizes in `oaStyle/Core/style.py` should be moved to its `Constants/` directory. 2. **Continuous Monitoring**: Developers should continue to move numeric literals to their respective `Constants/` files as they work on new features. The most critical offenders identified in the initial audit have been successfully refactored.
